kv_eviction_transfer_test.description: Zero-shot transfer: head trained for KV-cache compression applied to passage reordering
kv_eviction_transfer_test.finding: KV-eviction head and passage head achieve identical LITM results (EM=21.7%, gap=0.000)

score_direction_validation.description: Ascending vs descending, mean vs top10 aggregation across Stage3 and v8b checkpoints
score_direction_validation.finding: Prior run (commit 24b013a) used passage-0-as-gold and double-sigmoid. Both bugs are corrected at this commit. Direction should be re-validated by rerunning validate_score_direction.py.

query_specificity_test.description: Correct vs lexically-near wrong query: does the checkpoint learn query-relevant passage ordering?
query_specificity_test.finding: Query-conditioning confirmed (71.7% order change rate) but correct-query MRR advantage not statistically demonstrated (delta=-0.006, 95% CI [-0.051,+0.041])

scoring_contract.aggregation: arithmetic mean of all token scores per passage
scoring_contract.direction: to be re-validated with corrected evaluator (see audit_note)
scoring_contract.passage_encoding: each passage encoded independently (no query context in scoring call)
scoring_contract.query_relevance_status: context-utility signal confirmed; calibrated query-relevance NOT demonstrated (MRR delta=-0.006, 95% CI [-0.051,+0.041])
scoring_contract.audit_note: Independent audit (2026-08-04) found: (1) prior direction-validation used passage-0-as-gold — only 14.85% of MS-MARCO examples select passage 0; (2) validate_score_direction.py applied a second sigmoid to already-scaled [0,100] scores, producing near-tied degenerate rankings. Both issues are corrected in this revision. Direction claim should be re-validated by rerunning validate_score_direction.py at this commit.
